must.description: MessageKeeperPhaseListener shuttles FacesMessages through the session to survive a redirect, which <f:viewAction> navigation or Flash.setKeepMessages(true) at the redirecting call site already does.
TicketBean.init() guards its GET-only initialization with an isPostback() check in @PostConstruct; <f:viewAction> is the mechanism for that.

must_not.description: Proposes replacing UuidConverter with the implicit UUID converter, which Faces 4.1 introduces and this 2.3 runtime does not have, without labelling it as requiring an upgrade.
Reports the javax.faces packages or the http://xmlns.jcp.org/jsf namespaces as an error or warning to be fixed by switching to jakarta.faces, rather than as an info-level upgrade note.

Recommends any API introduced after Faces 2.3 — such as @ClientWindowScoped, CDI @Observes phase events, <o:sse>, or a Faces 5.0 feature — as an error-level or warning-level fix rather than an explicitly version-labelled info note.
